name: Vault of the Aureate
desc: The **Vault of The Aureate** is a location in Vow of Iron which you can access through a Boundary found in the back of [The Golden Rat](location:the_golden_rat). The Vault is a large hollowed out arena which serves as the fighting grounds for [Dravik, The Rat King](entity:dravik_the_rat_king), the mighty leader of the Golden Rats.
additional_info:
-   "Aureate" means to be made of or have the color of gold.
-   This area can not be accessed again after defeating Dravik on a character.
